correctness.rationale: For k≥1 conditioned on even jump count 2k and return, alternating holding-time simplex volumes give normalized density u^k(1−u)^{k−1} e^(−δu) with δ=(α−β)t; k=0 gives U=1. Folding A=|2U−1| gives likelihood ratio across k proportional to 1−a², strictly decreasing. Conditional mean gδ(a)=1/2+(a/2)tanh(atanh(a)−δa/2) increases for δ≤2. For δ>2, beta-tilt gives m_k=1/2+(2−δ)/(8k)+O(k^-2), approaching 1/2 from below so no global decreasing sequence. Independent high-precision integrals verify representative δ and k, not the universal asymptotic.
